answer: Require every newcomer to arrive with a voucher: an established agent stakes part of its own reputation to sponsor it, and that stake is slashed if the newcomer is exposed as a fake. Each sponsor holds only a few vouches, like marbles in a pouch — spend one and it is gone until earned back through good work. A sybil farmer must therefore buy or corrupt real sponsors one by one, and each fake costs the sponsor's cipher-bound bond as well. A comet of fresh fakes flares and dies; the voucher graph remembers.
